entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if power is available and the appliance still does not work. Use the separate urgent damaged-cord guidance if the cord is damaged.

entries.possibleCause: The temperature setting is too cold, the door is opened often or does not close fully, airflow is blocked, or the room is warm.
entries.safeUserCheck: Select a warmer/correct temperature setting, make sure food does not block the door or touch the rear wall, and check the wall clearance and room temperature.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if the compressor still runs continuously after the temperature, door, airflow, and placement checks.

entries.possibleCause: Water discharge opening clogged, or internal air circulation obstructed by food touching rear wall.
entries.safeUserCheck: Place food and containers so they do not touch the rear wall. If the model has an accessible discharge opening, clean it only as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if water returns after the obstruction is removed or the drain cannot be cleared safely.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked

entries.problem: Temperature too low or too high
entries.possibleCause: The temperature setting may be wrong; the room may be outside the climate range; the appliance may be near heat or sunlight; airflow may be blocked; the door may be opened often or not close fully; or too much warm food may have been loaded.
entries.safeUserCheck: Correct the temperature setting, keep at least 30 mm clearance behind the appliance, remove airflow and door obstructions, reduce door opening, and check the room temperature. After loading a large amount of warm food, allow up to 72 hours for the required temperature to return.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if the temperature remains incorrect after these checks and the normal waiting period.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 55 - Temperature inside the appliance is not low enough or too high
matchTerms: Temperature too low or too high

entries.problem: Door-open alarm sounds after about 3 minutes
entries.possibleCause: The refrigerator door has remained open for more than 3 minutes.
entries.safeUserCheck: Close the refrigerator door. Pressing a button can silence the buzzer temporarily, but it will sound again after about 3 minutes if the door remains open.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when the alarm stops after the door is closed. Create a claim if it continues with the door fully closed.
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, pp. 45-46 - Refrigerator door opening alarm

entries.problem: Newly switched-on appliance has not reached temperature yet
entries.possibleCause: At first startup, the appliance needs time to reach its operating temperature.
entries.safeUserCheck: Run the appliance empty for at least 4 hours before loading food.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed during the initial 4-hour cooling period. Create a claim if it still does not cool after enough time and the normal checks.
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 47 - Storage of food in the fridge-freezer

entries.problem: Temperature too high after loading food
entries.possibleCause: Too much warm food loaded at one time.
entries.safeUserCheck: Wait up to 72 hours for food to cool/freeze and required temperature to be reached.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim unless temperature does not recover after waiting.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 55 - Too much warm food loaded at one time
matchTerms: Temperature too high after loading food

entries.problem: Temporary temperature changes or longer compressor operation
entries.possibleCause: Putting fresh food inside, opening the door, or a warmer room can temporarily change the internal temperature and make the compressor run longer.
entries.safeUserCheck: Keep the door closed and allow the temperature to stabilize. Check that the room is within the appliance climate range.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for a temporary change. Create a claim if the temperature does not recover or the compressor never cycles off after conditions stabilize.
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 47 - Operating efficiency and temperature variation
matchTerms: fridge runs longer in hot weather

entries.possibleCause: Food or containers may block the door, or the door gasket may be inserted incorrectly, loose, torn, or deformed.
entries.safeUserCheck: Rearrange food so the door closes completely, press a displaced gasket back into place, and keep the seal clean.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim with a photo if the gasket is damaged, will not seat correctly, or the door still will not close.
evidenceToRequest: photo of leak/damage
short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 55 - Door closure and gasket checks

entries.possibleCause: Compressor/thermostat switching, cooling-agent flow, clicking bottles, shelves/drawers, or appliance not level.

entries.problem: Food becomes frosted or wet where it touches the rear wall
entries.possibleCause: Food or packaging is touching the cold rear wall of the refrigerator compartment.
entries.safeUserCheck: Move food and containers away from the rear wall so air can circulate around them.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed if the issue stops after moving the food. Create a claim if items freeze or become wet without touching the rear wall.
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 48 - Food storage in the refrigerator
matchTerms: food wet at back of fridge

entries.possibleCause: Vegetables with high water content release moisture inside the container.
entries.safeUserCheck: Dry wet vegetables before storage and remove excess moisture from the container.
entries.claimTrigger: This is normally not a fault. Create a claim only if there is broader uncontrolled water leakage.
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 48 - Food storage in the refrigerator

entries.problem: Freezer door is difficult to reopen immediately after closing
entries.possibleCause: Temporary negative pressure forms inside the freezer after the door is closed.
entries.safeUserCheck: Wait 1 to 2 minutes, then open the door again without forcing it.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed if the door opens normally after 1 to 2 minutes. Create a claim if it remains stuck or the seal is damaged.
matchTerms: freezer door is hard to open
hard to reopen freezer door immediately after closing

entries.problem: Frost or water droplets appear on the refrigerator rear wall
entries.possibleCause: This can occur during normal automatic defrosting of the refrigerator compartment.
entries.safeUserCheck: Keep food away from the rear wall and make sure the discharge opening is not obstructed. Do not scrape the cooling surface.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for temporary rear-wall frost or droplets. Create a claim if water collects in the bottom or heavy ice persists.
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 52 - Defrosting the fridge

entries.problem: Appliance was tilted more than 40 degrees during transport
entries.possibleCause: Oil and refrigerant need time to settle after the appliance is returned upright.
entries.safeUserCheck: Keep the appliance upright and wait at least 2 hours before switching it on.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed if the appliance works normally after the waiting period. Create a claim if cooling does not start afterward.
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, p. 38 - Transport and positioning
matchTerms: when can I switch on after transport

entries.problem: Supply cord is damaged, trapped, or crushed
entries.possibleCause: A damaged supply cord can create an electric shock or fire hazard.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the appliance. Do not plug it in, touch damaged conductors, tape the cord, or attempt a repair.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim. The cord must be replaced by the manufacturer, service agent, or a similarly qualified person.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the damaged or trapped cord without touching it
product model/serial number
entries.sourceSection: OL-KGCN388140E manual, pp. 38 and 40 - Supply cord safety

entries.problem: Refrigerant pipe is punctured, broken, or leaking
entries.possibleCause: A punctured or broken refrigerant pipe can release flammable refrigerant.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the appliance, avoid flames and ignition sources, ventilate the room for several minutes, and do not touch or repair the damaged pipe. If refrigerant contacts the eyes, rinse with clean water and seek medical help immediately.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim and keep the appliance out of use until checked by qualified service personnel.
evidenceToRequest: photo of visible damage only if it can be taken safely
product model/serial number
short description of how the damage occurred

entries.problem: Appliance does not fill with water
entries.possibleCause: Valve closed, programme settings, low pressure, supply hose disconnected/bent/blocked.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check valve, pressure, hose, door, and programme settings.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if still no fill.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked
matchTerms: Appliance does not fill with water

entries.possibleCause: Drain hose end too low.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check that the drain-hose end is above the water level in the appliance and that the hose is positioned 0.6-1 m above the floor.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if installation is correct but issue continues.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 29 - Lösen von Betriebsproblemen

entries.possibleCause: Pump filter, drain hose, or drain hose placement issue.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check pump filter, drain hose, and hose placement.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if water remains or pump/drain still fails.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked

entries.possibleCause: Transit bolts not removed, machine not level, feet not locked.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check transit bolts removed, level machine, tighten feet nuts.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if strong vibration continues.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked

entries.possibleCause: Too much detergent, wrong detergent, water hardness/detergent mismatch.
entries.safeUserCheck: Reduce detergent and use detergent according to manufacturer instructions.
entries.claimTrigger: Claim only if drawer leaks with correct detergent/use.
evidenceToRequest: photo of leak/damage
short description of what the user already checked

entries.possibleCause: Electrical power, water supply, or water outlet issue.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check power, water supply, and outlet.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if programme still interrupts.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked

entries.problem: Noise from outlet pump after water removed
entries.possibleCause: Normal pump operation after water drained.
entries.safeUserCheck: Explain this can be normal.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim unless noise is abnormal or continuous.
evidenceToRequest: video for noise/vibration
short description of what the user already checked
matchTerms: Noise from outlet pump after water removed

entries.possibleCause: Automatic refill or pause to remove excess foam.
entries.safeUserCheck: Explain this can be normal.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked

entries.possibleCause: Low water pressure or no water in washing machine.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open water valve; check water inlet hose/filter and water pressure.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if E10 remains after checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/error code
short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 30 - Anzeigen der Fehler-Codes

entries.possibleCause: Water does not drain properly.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check drain pump and filter.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if E21 remains or water stays inside.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/error code
short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 30 - Anzeigen der Fehler-Codes

entries.possibleCause: Door is not closed.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check door is fully closed and nothing is stuck in the door.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim if door/latch issue continues.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/error code
short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 30 - Anzeigen der Fehler-Codes

entries.possibleCause: The washing machine detected overfilling.
entries.safeUserCheck: Restart the appliance once.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if E12 returns after the restart.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/error code
product model/serial number
short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 30 - Anzeigen der Fehler-Codes

entries.problem: Display shows OVL / washing machine is overloaded
entries.possibleCause: The laundry load exceeds the permitted amount for the programme.
entries.safeUserCheck: Remove excess laundry and restart the washing machine.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if OVL remains with a load within the programme limit.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/error code
product model/serial number
short description of the laundry load

entries.possibleCause: The programme is still running, water remains in the drum, or the temperature is too high.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not force the door. Wait for the programme to finish and for the appliance to unlock the door automatically.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if the door stays locked after the programme has ended, the water has drained, and the appliance has cooled.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/door-lock symbol
product model/serial number
short description of whether water remains in the drum

entries.problem: Function buttons are blocked / Child Lock is active
entries.possibleCause: Child Lock is enabled and remains enabled after the wash ends until it is switched off.
entries.safeUserCheck: Press and hold Start Delay and Spin Speed together for about 3 seconds to switch Child Lock off.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if the controls remain blocked after Child Lock is switched off as documented.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/Child Lock symbol
short description of what the user already checked

entries.possibleCause: Start Delay is selected.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check the Start Delay setting. The wash starts automatically when the selected delay expires.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when Start Delay is active.
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 28 - Einstellung der Startverzögerung

entries.problem: Remaining-time display temporarily freezes or jumps
entries.possibleCause: The displayed time is a forecast that updates according to temperature, water pressure, load size, and detergent amount.
entries.safeUserCheck: Allow the programme to continue; temporary pauses and time changes are documented behaviour.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for temporary time changes by themselves.

entries.possibleCause: Spinning is switched off in the selected programme settings.
entries.safeUserCheck: Select an available spin speed if spinning is required.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when 0 spin speed is selected.

entries.possibleCause: Cold-water washing without preheating is selected.
entries.safeUserCheck: Select another available wash temperature if heated washing is required.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when the cold-water setting is selected.

entries.problem: Programme knob does not change the active wash programme
entries.possibleCause: Moving the programme knob after a programme starts does not change the active programme parameters.
entries.safeUserCheck: Use Standby to cancel the programme, then select the desired programme and press Start/Pause.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when the active programme behaves as documented.
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 25 - Programmknopf; p. 28 - Abbrechen und Wechsel des Waschprogramms

entries.problem: Wash programme resumes after a power interruption
entries.possibleCause: The programme memory retains the started programme during a power interruption.
entries.safeUserCheck: Do not open the door during the power interruption. Allow the stored programme to resume after power returns.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed if the programme resumes as documented.
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 34 - Spannungsschwund (Memory des Waschprogramms)

entries.possibleCause: Unspecified fault.
entries.safeUserCheck: Try restart once.
entries.claimTrigger: Create claim/contact service if error remains.
evidenceToRequest: photo of display/error code
short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: EWA 34660 W manual, p. 30 - Anzeigen der Fehler-Codes

entries.possibleCause: Break in power supply.
entries.safeUserCheck: Make sure an oven function and temperature are selected, then check the household fuse/power supply. Do not open or repair internal electrical parts.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if power is available and the oven still does not work after the documented control check.
evidenceToRequest: short description of what the user already checked
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, pp. 67 and 79 - Operation / Operation in case of emergency

entries.problem: Programmer display shows flashing 0.00 after connection or a power cut
entries.possibleCause: The appliance was disconnected from the mains, power was interrupted, or the current time has not been set. This is a clock indication, not a fault code.
entries.safeUserCheck: This is a clock indication, not a fault code. For an oven fitted with the optional electronic timer, set the current time using MENU and the < / > sensors. The oven cannot operate until the time is set.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed if operation returns after setting the clock. Create a claim if the clock cannot be set or repeatedly resets while household power is stable.
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, pp. 64-65 and 79 - Electronic timer / Operation in case of emergency
matchTerms: oven does not work after power cut

entries.possibleCause: Bulb loose or damaged.
entries.safeUserCheck: Switch off and unplug the oven, allow it to cool completely, then tighten or replace the 230 V / 25 W halogen bulb using the documented lamp procedure. Do not work on the lamp while power is connected.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if the light still does not work after the documented bulb check or the lamp cannot be accessed safely.
evidenceToRequest: short description of whether oven heating still works and what was checked
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, pp. 75 and 79 - Replacing the halogen bulb / Operation in case of emergency

entries.problem: Oven function is selected but the oven does not heat
entries.possibleCause: The temperature regulator may still be set to zero. On applicable functions, only the fan operates when no temperature is selected.
entries.safeUserCheck: Select the intended oven function and set the required temperature. Allow normal preheating time; do not open or repair internal parts.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if the oven still does not heat after both the function and temperature are correctly selected.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the selected function and temperature knob positions
short description of whether the fan or indicator lights operate
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, pp. 67-68 - Oven functions and operation

entries.problem: Fan runs without heat in Defrost mode
entries.possibleCause: This is the documented Defrost function: only the fan operates and all heaters remain off.
entries.safeUserCheck: In Defrost mode only the fan operates and all heaters remain off, so no corrective action is needed. Choose a heating function and temperature if heating is intended.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for fan-only operation in Defrost mode.
matchTerms: fan runs without heat in defrost

entries.problem: Temperature-regulator light L goes out or cycles on and off
entries.possibleCause: The light goes out when the selected temperature is reached and cycles during cooking while the thermostat maintains that temperature.
entries.safeUserCheck: No action is required when heating is otherwise normal. Wait for light L to go out the first time before placing food in a preheated oven.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for normal thermostat-light cycling. Create a claim if the oven does not heat or the light never behaves consistently with heating.
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, p. 68 - Signal lights R and L
matchTerms: temperature light turns on and off

entries.problem: Kitchen Timer alarm sounds and its symbol flashes
entries.possibleCause: On an oven fitted with the optional electronic timer, the programmed Kitchen Timer has elapsed.
entries.safeUserCheck: Touch and hold MENU, or hold the < / > sensors together, to mute the alarm. If untouched, it stops automatically after approximately 7 minutes.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when the alarm corresponds to an elapsed Kitchen Timer.

entries.problem: Oven switches off automatically and an alarm sounds after timed operation
entries.possibleCause: On an oven fitted with the optional electronic timer, the programmed Duration has elapsed.
entries.safeUserCheck: Set the function and temperature knobs to off, then hold MENU or the < / > sensors together to mute the alarm.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed when a programmed Duration has elapsed. Create a claim if the oven switches off unexpectedly without timed operation.

entries.problem: Display briefly shows dur, ton, or bri
entries.possibleCause: These are programmer menu indicators: dur means Duration, ton means beep-tone adjustment, and bri means display-brightness adjustment. They are not fault codes.
entries.safeUserCheck: These are programmer menu indicators, not fault codes: dur is Duration, ton is tone, and bri is brightness. Continue or exit the setting using MENU and the < / > sensors as documented.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for these menu indicators by themselves.
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, pp. 65-66 - Timed operation / Tone / Brightness

entries.problem: Programmer display becomes dim at night
entries.possibleCause: On ovens fitted with the optional electronic timer, Night Mode dims the display from 22:00 to 06:00.
entries.safeUserCheck: No action is required. Display brightness can also be adjusted from 1 to 9 in the bri menu.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for normal Night Mode dimming.
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, p. 66 - Adjust display brightness / Night Mode

entries.problem: Oven interior light is off during ECO Heating
entries.possibleCause: The oven lighting remains off by design in ECO Heating mode.
entries.safeUserCheck: No action is required if the oven heats normally in ECO mode. Select independent oven lighting only when needed.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for the light being off only in ECO Heating. Use the lighting-fault guidance if it stays off in other modes.

entries.problem: Heat escapes around the oven door
entries.possibleCause: The door may not be fully closed, or spillages and dirt may prevent the door seal from sealing correctly.
entries.safeUserCheck: Let the oven cool, make sure the door closes fully, and clean spillages from the door seal without using abrasive tools.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a claim if heat still escapes because the door or seal is damaged or does not close correctly after cleaning.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the cooled door and seal
short description of what was cleaned or checked
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, p. 58 - How to save energy

entries.problem: Hot steam escapes when the oven door is opened
entries.possibleCause: Hot, sometimes invisible steam can normally escape when the door is opened during or after cooking.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open the door carefully, keep your face and body back, and do not lean over the open door.
entries.claimTrigger: No claim is needed for normal steam when opening the door. Create a claim if there is uncontrolled leakage while the door is closed or visible door damage.
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, p. 57 - Danger of burns

entries.problem: Fixed oven power supply cable is damaged
entries.possibleCause: A damaged fixed power cable creates an electrical safety hazard.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the oven and disconnect power only if this can be done safely. Do not repair, tape, or replace the cable yourself.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim. The cable must be replaced by the manufacturer, an authorised service outlet, or a qualified person.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the damaged cable only if it can be taken without touching it
product model/serial number

entries.problem: Oven door glass is cracked or shattered
entries.possibleCause: Scratched or damaged door glass can crack or shatter, including after abrasive cleaners or sharp metal scrapers are used.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the oven. Do not touch, press, clean, or continue using damaged door glass.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for cracked or shattered oven-door glass.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the damaged glass from a safe distance
product model/serial number
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, pp. 56-57 - Door glass safety

entries.problem: Technical oven fault remains after documented checks
entries.possibleCause: An internal technical or operational fault requires qualified service.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the oven, switch both controls off, and disconnect power if safe. Do not open the appliance or attempt an internal repair.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim when a technical fault remains after the documented safe checks.
evidenceToRequest: product model/serial number
short description of the symptom and checks already completed
entries.sourceSection: A-EBX943600S manual, pp. 57, 78-79 - Technical faults / Service
